answer: Propose one paid key per surveyed river intake site, at least 1 km from another, leased for 60 days. Its prism spectrometer signs surprise spectra on a spiral sampling schedule; independent inspectors audit coordinates and simultaneous readings. Proposed validators deny pay if a site ID repeats or a reading is missing, and slash escrow for a proven forged signed location. A farm can share software and rent sites, but each extra clone costs a distinct occupied kilometre, live instrument and 60-day lease; borrowed cash cannot reuse a site. Colluding inspectors defeat this gate.
